But, Dong Ying Club, Crow and Tiger open a karaoke club opposite to Chan's sticking a foot into his territory. On the other hand, Dong Ying succeeds in having Chang assassinated in Holland and frame Chan for his death. It's another challenge to Chan.

programme.title: 影人映語 -走過香港電影的興衰-文雋
programme.desc: Film producer Manfred Wong debuted as a scriptwriter who had been working for various film production companies in Hong Kong. Born in 1950s, he went through the heyday of film industry; witnessed the prosperity of homegrown productions in 1980s to 90s; heard rumor about a superstar being kidnapped to abrupt shooting; but also lamented for decade of steady decline of the city's film industry. Acted as a time witness, he is going to tell us the ups and downs of Hong Kong cinema.

Chen Sung Yung plays a fellow inmate from the Mainland, Lung who befriends Ching. When he is framed for murder, Ching is implicated in fingering him. Ching and Lung must break out of prison to stay alive..

programme.desc: Athena is an aromatherapy tutor but can't heal up her wound at heart. One day, she finds a broken-wing angel falling on balcony. A scented romance is gradually in between them..

programme.title: 西遊記之仙履奇緣
programme.desc: The Joker travels back in time to save his beloved, the reformed devil Boney M. But instead of the right place and right time, he finds himself stranded in five hundred years back..

programme.title: 賭霸
programme.desc: Do Do is everything Anita is not. Do Do is the brash, uncouth kind of a fishwife, while Anita is the personification of elegance, intellect and perfect deportment. Do Do works at a fish store but hopes to be a clairvoyant but Anita has this extra-sensory perception power by birth. Uncle's enterprise is in danger as top gambler Sung issues a challenge. Uncle asks Anita to take on Sung but she refuses. In desperation, Uncle goes to Do Do who playfully claims to be the ESP queen of gamblers..

programme.title: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: The story is about sing, who becomes a traffic cop, determines to be an undercover again at school to regain his reputation of being a leader of SDU.

programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Fatboy is also being reprimanded by Grand Uncle for being rude to his fiancee, Yuen. The last of the Mas, the rich family in town, is back but Ma Lucho is coming home dead. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent..

programme.title: 辣手回春
programme.desc: This is the first day of work for Yan at Sir Kau Kei Ho Charity Hospital's A&E. Yan is shocked to find that Jim, teaching her shedding job responsibility. An old man is taken to A&E after being struck by lightening. Each department dispatches him to one another but scrambling to take him after knowing that he is Ho Kau Kei. Ho wants to abolish the hospital's bureaucratic system, by appointing Yan, together with Joe and Jim to make changes by their own ways..

programme.title: 龍虎風雲
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.desc: Two men fall journey into the far-reaches of China, but stumble upon a cave where Princess Wendy, her handmaid Mandy, and evil Tin have been in suspended animation for 800 years..

programme.desc: Rumors have it that the Shaolin Temple is harbouring revolutionaries. The emperor believes the rumors and decides to wipe out the temple. Fong Sai-yuk escapes with his uncle to the desert. There they run into Tou Tou. Yuk's uncle is killed by the king's general, and Tou and Yuk are captured. They are taken to the Red Lotus Temple; the temple is run by Elder Kung. Hung Hei Koon, has already joined Elder Kung and voluntarily becomes his protege. Yuk looks for every chance to escape but is stopped by Koon and Koon is just pretending to have joined Elder Kung. With Koon's help, Yuk finally defeats Elder Kung..

programme.desc: Imperial Court member Wai Siu-Bo is sent forward in time to present-day Hong Kong, to find a woman who can cure the Emperor of his illness. Can Siu-Bo accomplish his mission.

programme.desc: Chieh-ying, the head of a Macau dancing group, has a peaceful and calm life. One day, five drunken men, who were the murderers of Chieh-ying's dad, came to watch the show and had a brawl with Chieh-ying. On her way home, Chieh-ying got caught. She was raped and tortured by them. After that, Chieh-ying felt herself sick and was contracted the venereal disease. Therefore, she decided to go to Hong Kong to seek vengeance. She met a journalist and stayed at his home. To earn a living, Chieh-ying worked as a barmaid at a bar of Chow, her sister's ex-boyfriend with the help from Susan. One evening, Chieh-ying saw one of those five men when she was on the way to work. Susan lured him away so Chieh-ying could kill him. Chieh-ying then started a trail of bloody revenge..

Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge..

programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 喋血街頭
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs..

Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

programme.title: 烈火戰車
programme.desc: Andy is a seasoned motor-cycle driver. His ultimate goal is to enroll in Grand Prix Racing. But in a private race, a severe crash almost took Andy's life..

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conqueror..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.desc: Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing..

Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them..

programme.title: 浪漫殺手自由人
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins.

programme.title: 賭聖2之街頭賭聖
programme.desc: Lui puts forward a masked Saint of gamblers to cover for him in the casino. Meanwhile, Uncle Sam sets out in search of the new Saint since the real saint of gamblers retires..

programme.title: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

programme.title: 皇家師姐
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. As the duo try to work around each other's polarized cultures and background, they kick and punch their way through the investigation, leading to 2 small time pickpockets Strepsil and Panadol, who had stolen the passport containing the evidence from the agent before he died. As the bumbling pickpockets try to dodge the assassins in hot pursuit, they eventually turn to the lady cops for help against the crime boss..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之女皇密令
programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters. Mr Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led carried out his mission successfully for Mr Bond, he is summoned by the Governor to assist Collons in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr BOnd's gang.

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 想你‧張國榮: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 精裝追女仔3狼之一族
programme.desc: Personal and interest conflicts between two garage owners Ken and Jim along with Ken's four young men staffs and Jim's four young girl helpers make them compete with each other..

programme.title: 致命性騷擾
programme.desc: Office worker Amy goes berserk and tries to stab her boss, Cheuk, accusing him of sexual harassment and rape. The higher-ups accept Amy's description of the event and Cheuk is suspended, in spite of the fact that in-house lawyer Joe believes the man is innocent..

programme.title: 衛斯理傳奇
programme.desc: Wisely, the scholar-adventurer is obsessed with myth and exotic things. Anticipating to solve the puzzle of David's absence, he went to Nepal to rescue his old buddy, who was exploring a legendary cult in the Himalayas. Disguised as a monk, Wisely's identity was revealed by the spiritual leader, a five-year old child monk. After the escape, David disappeared with the holy pearl of the cult. For the sake of the cult and the child monk, Wisely promised to retrieve the pearl. Howard Hope, the multi-national industrialist, sent his assistant Sheena to offer Wisely three million dollars for the pears. Wisely turned down the offer. From the telephone message left by David, Wisely knew that he was with Pak, the master of the Ching Society, who sponsored David's research..

programme.title: 情人知己
programme.desc: Chi is equipped with superb gaming skills, and because of that he is a very egoistic and lazy worker. One day he flirts with a girl who happen to be a mafia boss' girlfriend..

programme.title: 上海假期
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.title: 殺手的童話
programme.desc: Judge was one of the top killers of ICE's syndicate. Mr. Tung Fai, a super cop attempted to sue the Triad head, Godfather “Tiger”. Unfortunately, his witness gave false testimony. Worst still, the witness was shot by Judge who impersonated as the presiding Judge in the law court. Meanwhile, Judge met Ru-fung, sister of Ice and both fell in love. The two killers understood they could not have true love. They decided to enjoy love for 3 days, and then separate and return to their killing carrier again.

programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release..

programme.title: 帶子洪郎
programme.desc: Hung is a stuntman living with his troublesome father, Kwun. Five years ago, he deeply fell in love with May. Yet May's father strongly objected their relations and separated them trickily, with the help of Kwun. One day, May come backs - but with her six-year-old son, Sam. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..

programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 抱擁朝陽
programme.desc: Han Zhiyi‘s father took his life after he was rigged by Yi Zufen and Zhiyi was forced to close down her family business. She was distressed and went for a vacation with her mother. They left Shanghai and joined a cruise to Hong Kong. On the liner, she met billionaire Tong Paixian who fell deeply in love with her at first sight..

programme.title: 想你‧張國榮: 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Disc jockey Piggy Chan, mechanic Sapi and cousin Hayden are good friends. Three of them form a trio - LOVEBURSTERS. Piggy falls in love at first sight with Jane Yu. He tears down all obstacles to win her heart. With the victory, he resumes his inclination to flirt around. His friends and relatives are very upset to see him deserting Jane..

programme.title: 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued..

programme.title: 色情男女
programme.desc: Leslie is a young film director whose works had poor box office. Being unemployed, he gets an offer to direct a vulgar commercial film. He has to succumb to the reality..

programme.title: 明月照尖東
programme.desc: Police detective Ming loses his gun during a drunken binge and attempts to recover it while romancing PR girl Tweedy. That's the gist of the first two-thirds of the slackly-paced story, which is enlivened by a gun battle, a chase on foot through speeding cars, and comic relief provided by Ming's partner. Things really heat up, though, when Tweedy's old boyfriend Prince, a psychotic killer, comes back to town..

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: The one who solves hermit Ding's chess game will become the grand master of martial arts. A shaolin young monk must solve the complex game to forestall great calamity..

programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target..

programme.desc: Master, The of Eva Palace enters the valley in search of 10 Untouchable Villians. Despite being married and having a child together, she and Yin fight each other without remorse.

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 猛鬼撞鬼
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

programme.title: 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: 中華英雄
programme.desc: Hero goes home with excited but he finds his parent was killed. Gian took a group of foreigners to Hero's parents and forced them to hand over the Red Sword, their family treasure..

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 想你‧張國榮: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: Lee Ah Chai, a native Chiu Chow, a province of China. He was married with children of his own. He was rich, powerful and influential and he was the leading man in the underworld, virtually to as the ‘Big Boss'. But he was unhappy. After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. But a misconception broke out which overshadowed the relationship amongst the three of them. It led Chai and Yung to divergence and the fight of Kok to Malacca..

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWTNewly minted copilot Jeff Tapper is excited for his first revenue DC-3, but his inexperience shows when he botches the approach and bounces the landing three times, nearly running off the runway. Meanwhile, for new rampie Prefkar Mony to realize his dream of becoming a DC-3 pilot, he needs to first pass the written IATRA test. He’s been studying for months, but on his first attempt, he fails. With the help of pilot/mechanic Chris Staples, Prefkar retakes the test and passes, but his victory celebration is short-lived when he’s blamed for leaving an expensive shipment of medicine marked “Do Not Freeze” in a courier van during a minus 30 weekend. Later, Mikey and Katie decide to find Joe a new dog and choose Muffy, a three-year-old dog from the SPCA who is ready to leave her pups. They bring her back to the hangar for a test drive. Joe brings DC-3 CUE out of retirement to test fly the plane for Buffalo’s summer sked duty and he brings along Jeff—and Muffy—to see if they’re.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey talks to a 15-year-old aviation buff in England via Skype, who has discovered that Buffalo’s DC3–WZS–flew on D-Day. This inspires Mikey to do something special for the 70th anniversary. He invites Cory to do a tandem parachute jump and finds out that Cory’s grandfather was a paratrooper at the invasion of Normandy. Meanwhile, Mikey takes mercy on Prefkar, working the ramp in Hay River, and offers him a chance for some pilot training on the morning DC-3 freighter. But when the time comes, Prefkar learns that he’s been bumped for pilot David Alexandre. It gets worse for Prefkar when he’s given another chance and this time the fog rolls in. Prefkar might not stick it out at Buffalo. Mikey’s D-Day plans get even bigger when he contacts the Princess Patricia Canadian Light Infantry, who were part of the Allied airborne forces that dropped behind German lines in 1944. He pitches his plan—a reenactment jump from WZS, an actual D-Day plane. But there’s a hitch: the plane needs to pass in.

programme.title: Mega Makeover 第1季
programme.desc: Heide Park Soltau, a german adventure park, offers adrenaline junkies many attractions and rides. The biggest crowd puller is the Colossos wooden roller coaster - the highest and fastest wooden roller coaster in Europe. But over twenty million passengers in fifteen years are taking their toll. The ride closes temporarily and renovation work begins. It is a gigantic task - 1500 metres of track have to be renewed. A complete replacement of all wooden rails has never been done on a comparable facility before. It is a renovation of superlatives for 12.5 million euros. The team is working with the heavy components at heights of up to 60 metres. Safety technology and its correct application are vital. The reopening date is approaching and the pressure is mounting.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWTNewly minted copilot Jeff Tapper is excited for his first revenue DC-3, but his inexperience shows when he botches the approach and bounces the landing three times, nearly running off the runway. Meanwhile, for new rampie Prefkar Mony to realize his dream of becoming a DC-3 pilot, he needs to first pass the written IATRA test. He’s been studying for months, but on his first attempt, he fails. With the help of pilot/mechanic Chris Staples, Prefkar retakes the test and passes, but his victory celebration is short-lived when he’s blamed for leaving an expensive shipment of medicine marked “Do Not Freeze” in a courier van during a minus 30 weekend. Later, Mikey and Katie decide to find Joe a new dog and choose Muffy, a three-year-old dog from the SPCA who is ready to leave her pups. They bring her back to the hangar for a test drive. Joe brings DC-3 CUE out of retirement to test fly the plane for Buffalo’s summer sked duty and he brings along Jeff—and Muffy—to see if they’re.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey talks to a 15-year-old aviation buff in England via Skype, who has discovered that Buffalo’s DC3–WZS–flew on D-Day. This inspires Mikey to do something special for the 70th anniversary. He invites Cory to do a tandem parachute jump and finds out that Cory’s grandfather was a paratrooper at the invasion of Normandy. Meanwhile, Mikey takes mercy on Prefkar, working the ramp in Hay River, and offers him a chance for some pilot training on the morning DC-3 freighter. But when the time comes, Prefkar learns that he’s been bumped for pilot David Alexandre. It gets worse for Prefkar when he’s given another chance and this time the fog rolls in. Prefkar might not stick it out at Buffalo. Mikey’s D-Day plans get even bigger when he contacts the Princess Patricia Canadian Light Infantry, who were part of the Allied airborne forces that dropped behind German lines in 1944. He pitches his plan—a reenactment jump from WZS, an actual D-Day plane. But there’s a hitch: the plane needs to pass in.

programme.title: 粵菜大師
programme.desc: Masters of Cantonese Cuisine is a documentary on Lingnan (Guangdong) delicacies culture, originally created by Shenzhen Satellite TV. This is a brief history of food belonging to the Greater Bay Area, a history of customs and culture that belongs exclusively to Guangdong. The program focus on the local Guangdong delicacies, and led by a “delicacy searcher”, walking through streets in search of local specialities, visiting masters of Cantonese cuisines, and sharing unique tasting commentaries. In the meantime, the reflection on delicacies would be brought back to live studio, and two observers who are proficient in Cantonese cuisine cultures will have chats on tasting. From a spoon and a drop, it will extend to the taste of life and origin of culture embedded in the delicacies.

長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：蘇諒答應李善德會爭取胡商的關注
programme.desc: 蘇諒得知朝集會提前召開，分析出因為何有光看出轉運荔枝的前景，他感受到了威脅，不想讓別的胡商給李善德投錢。蘇諒答應李善德，自己會去朝集會上爭取胡商的關注，只要李善德這次試驗讓他們看到希望.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 位于南大屿山的大东山，有海拔869米高，是香港第三高的山。每年秋天时分芒草盛开，是游人登山的旺季。. 但除了芒草之外，山上还有各种有趣又珍稀的植物，今次由专家带领，引导主持寻找那些平日被忽略的植物。. 为了在大东山上看日出，主持决定在位于南大屿郊野公园内的南山营地扎营，凌晨再出发登顶，决心要在大东山上捕捉旭日东升的景象.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：羅英子涉嫌詐騙被捕
programme.desc: 夏舒加入羅英子和邱華後，三人約見了馬麗麗。馬麗麗再一次向二人提出找許建設簽下代處理房產的委託書，遭到嚴厲拒絕。之後，羅英子和邱華再次會見許建設，並勸他走輕罪辯護，最終他同意。此時，羅英子突然因涉嫌詐騙銀行被警察拘捕，她再次找來邱華作為她的代理律師.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第十五集：玻利維亞 - 帶來希望的飛機師
programme.desc: Ivo Daniel Velasquez是一位無名英雄。他控制著飛機，有時是架小型塞斯納，有時是雙引擎派珀，無懼玻利維亞與別不同的飛行條件，前赴該國最偏遠的社區提供援助。. 從安第斯山脈到阿爾蒂普拉諾高原，到亞馬遜雨林，每當Ivo的飛機在最不可思議的跑道上降落，對當地社區而言，他代表與外界的重要聯繫。他不會以此大做文章，但若沒有他，遇上分娩困難的艾瑪拉族孕婦、在安第斯山脈的危險馬路上因意外受傷的蓋楚亞司機，或在林中被蛇咬傷的池曼小孩，能夠活著抵達醫院的機會都會變得渺茫。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年1月8日 星期一晚上10時30分 Ivo Daniel Velasquez is an anonymous hero. At the controls of his plane, sometimes a tiny Cessna, sometimes a twin-engine Piper - he defies the quite extraordinary flying conditions of Bolivia to come to the assistance of the most remote communities in the country. Whenever, Ivo lands his plane on the most unlikely airstrips, from the Andes and the Altiplano to Amazonia, for these communities he represents a vital link with the rest of the world. He doesn’t make a big deal about it, but, without him, the Aymara Indian woman having a difficult labor, the Quechua driver injured in an accident on dangerous road in the Andes or the Tsimane child bitten by a snake in the forest, would all have only a slim chance of reaching a hospital alive. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.01.08 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥的牙齒鬆動了，展示後就掉了，讓他傷心。他們到史前世界找牙齒，遇到因毯子破而難過的沙沙羅。小麥借了沙沙羅和阿福的牙齒，但都不合適，還被牙齒仙子搶走。最後，他們用木瓜毛編織新毯子，小麥明白了道理，決定收藏掉落的牙齒.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 胡同裡的狗半夜狂吠，朝風無法入睡，決定解決問題。發現兩隻地鼠偷水果，惹得狗狗叫。朝風想攻擊地鼠，菲菲卻讓它們躲進小院子，地鼠答應不再偷東西，狗吠聲隨之消失.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 小鎮正舉辦人氣之星的大賽，獲讚最多就是小鎮人氣之星。子涵在灶君的幫助下，得到了一張萬人追捧符，果然子涵人氣飆升，正當子涵以為人氣全部歸功於神器，卻發現剛剛忙中出錯，拿到的只是一張普通的促銷標籤，自己的人氣是憑自己的實力獲得，是小鎮真正的人氣之星.

programme.title: 不就是拔河麼
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 眾人助熊曉曉舉辦首唱會
programme.desc: 熊曉曉的首唱會因為場地問題被取消。薛天為了幫助熊曉曉，召集拔河隊成員用拔河館作為演出場地，給熊曉曉驚喜。熊曉曉終於實現自己的夢想站上了舞臺，並將自己寫了三年的歌送給了郭炎，熊曉曉回憶起高中時的郭炎和林羽，觸碰到郭炎最不願提及的傷痛.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：姜小海的姐姐是販毒集團主腦？
programme.desc: 姜小海的姐姐姜迎紫，當年是宋哥眾多情婦中的一個，她隨宋哥去了南方，在三哥出事後，她收復了一批三哥的手下，回哈嵐重操舊業。雖然姜迎紫被列為嫌疑人，但龍哥和姜迎紫的關聯始終沒有被找到。姜迎紫知道自己被盯上，提醒龍哥與其他手下，行動要更加小心.

programme.title: 雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：專案組盯梢姜迎紫
programme.desc: 專案組盯梢姜迎紫，發現了密切接觸者－白玲。當初查抄夜總會時，白玲是裡面的清潔主管，鄭北曾簡單問她，沒問題就放走了。現在看來，白玲很可能是夜店真正的負責人，而清潔身分只是掩護。夜晚，鄭北、顧一燃盯守白玲期間，龍哥突然出現.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥在臥室玩，不願意洗澡，認為自己乾淨。他啟動蛋仔到史前時代，被紅豆和綠豆弄髒。臭味引來昆蟲，逃跑後躺在灌木叢裡。聽到木瓜提醒，他驚慌逃回家，明白了洗澡的重要性.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師帶全班到後海看流星雨，卻發現隕石朝他們飛來！杜老師組織撤離，如福和榮老闆展開拔河賽。菲菲讓脊獸們合力擊碎隕石，碎片掉落後海，避免災難.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 子軒無意中看到下棋的灶君，利用神環放慢時間作弊，作為要挾子軒明白了神環可以加速減速。子軒趁機奪走神環並給灶君減速，得到神環的子軒開始利用神環玩遊戲作弊，沒想到神環使用過度，子軒停不下來，而灶君則慢得過分.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：圍城試驗失敗了
programme.desc: 所有人翹首期盼，可圍城試驗還是失敗了，所有人都絕望了，包括李善德自己。就在這時，李善德看到在圍城跑試驗第一天就陪在一旁的孩童守護的那株插在草堆上的荔枝，竟然沒有腐壞.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：陳碩暗中幫羅英子脫罪
programme.desc: 馬麗馬麗麗約見夏舒，請求她轉交一封信給許建設。夏舒礙於她的苦苦哀求，只好暫時收下信。另外，邱華和方麗虹到看守所會見被捕的羅英子，經商量後決定去找陳碩幫忙。邱華把事情告知陳碩，陳碩雖口頭拒絕，但暗中點撥了邱華，讓她找到了銀行的監控視頻，羅英子終被釋放出來.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部研究助理教授曾憲發博士，分享有關香港下游魚類的生態知識。本集以黑紫枝牙鰕虎魚、高體鰟鮍和叉尾鬥魚作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索本地下游魚類的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦中國傳統色彩中的黃色與紅色，展現帝王專屬色如何融入民間生活。通過植物提取黃色、緙絲技藝、香港書法家華戈的朱砂紅招牌等案例，詮釋色彩的文化演變。運用動畫及光影設計，凸顯青花瓷等器物的古典美感.

programme.desc: 主持 Brian 與Vicky將會帶大家走進全港最大規模的電影場景展「九龍城寨光影之旅」，重現七記冰室、龍城髮廊等經典場景，更透過氣味與聲效帶你瞬間重回80年代。除了懷舊打卡，兩人還會展開一場美食與回憶之行：由旺角泰國街頭小食到深水埗玩具街的童年回憶，最後再到西九龍中心掃街，帶你玩轉香港最地道的舊城風情.

programme.desc: 馬麗馬麗麗約見夏舒，請求她轉交一封信給許建設。夏舒礙於她的苦苦哀求，只好暫時收下信。另外，邱華和方麗虹到看守所會見被捕的羅英子，經商量後決定去找陳碩幫忙。邱華把事情告知陳碩，陳碩雖口頭拒絕，但暗中點撥了邱華，讓她找到了銀行的監控視頻，羅英子終被釋放出來.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥在臥室玩，不願意洗澡，認為自己乾淨。他啟動蛋仔到史前時代，被紅豆和綠豆弄髒。臭味引來昆蟲，逃跑後躺在灌木叢裡。聽到木瓜提醒，他驚慌逃回家，明白了洗澡的重要性.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師帶全班到後海看流星雨，卻發現隕石朝他們飛來！杜老師組織撤離，如福和榮老闆展開拔河賽。菲菲讓脊獸們合力擊碎隕石，碎片掉落後海，避免災難.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 子軒無意中看到下棋的灶君，利用神環放慢時間作弊，作為要挾子軒明白了神環可以加速減速。子軒趁機奪走神環並給灶君減速，得到神環的子軒開始利用神環玩遊戲作弊，沒想到神環使用過度，子軒停不下來，而灶君則慢得過分.

programme.title: 不就是拔河麼
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 郭炎的心結
programme.desc: 郭炎在好友林羽的忌日這天回到老家祭拜林羽，意外的碰上了林羽的父母。另一邊，熊曉曉告訴眾人林羽的事，眾人理解了郭炎近期的反常。郭炎決定面對自己的心魔，林羽的父母拿出林羽留下的信件，郭炎看過信後終於解開了心結.

programme.desc: 除夕夜，林江看上了二金的女兒金菲，將她拖進了包房……事後金菲到派出所報警，派出所執勤員警正在記錄金菲的指控，姜迎紫帶著白玲、林江趕到派出所，一面解釋是一場誤會，只是夫妻吵架；一面對金菲語帶威脅。值班員警撤銷了報案，口頭教育了一下就放他們走了.

programme.title: 雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：二金為女兒交代一切
programme.desc: 律師來看守所見二金，閒聊中提到金菲時，律師的語氣稍顯不自然，二金發覺了。二金主動約見鄭北，希望警方能確認金菲是否安全。鄭北二話不說答應下來。二金哥再無顧忌，交代一切。他知道對方給了秦義一件衣服，稱那就是方法。由此，鄭北、顧一燃有了搜毒方向，有助抓人.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記

programme.sub-title: 第二十集：賀紅玲和肖春生分手
programme.desc: 肖春生知道父親去世後悲痛不已。佟曉梅開解肖春生，他永遠是他爸爸的驕傲。賀紅玲對肖春生說自己即將成為文團的隊長，到肖春生做文職時，兩個人就結婚。這並不是肖春生想要的。肖春生在輪椅上看葉國華的演講，心中五味雜陳。賀紅玲最後選擇了事業，和肖春生分手.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海

programme.desc: 說到「英雄」，很多時會默認「英雄」就是男性。但一講到出色的女性，就變成「女英雄」或者「英雌」。這可能是一種默認的反擊：不是要和男性對打，而是要告訴大家女性都可以是故事的中心。本集就談談英雌演化論。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 黃梓勇(大學講師). 葉子亭(應用文化研究助理教授). #英雌演化論#女英雄#女主角#巾幗英雄#女性文學.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.sub-title: Episode 5 “The Spark of Science: The Art of Running A Distinguished Award”
programme.desc: Science progresses rapidly and shapes our future. While fully enjoying the convenience brought by applied technologies, have we ever stopped and thought about whom and what insights the basic science, which laid the foundation for everything, actually originated from?. This episode covers the Future Science Prize 10th Anniversary Special Session, with the theme “How to Run a Successful Prize?”, and where leading global scientists gathered together. “Basic science” explores the origin of the universe, the essence of matter and the life mechanism, which, in spite of being abstract in nature, have far-reaching impacts. On the other hand, “applied science”, just like a relay, continues to transform the results into medical, engineering and electronic technologies, so as to improve human life. Many important scientific awards focus on basic research because it opens up endless possibilities. . How should a scientific award with credibility and long-term impact be operated? In this programme, Professor Anderson Ho-cheung SHUM is invited to be the docent, and listen to the practice wisdom on the selection mechanism, the fairness principle and talent motivation shared by the leading scientists together with the audience. A distinguished award is the key to igniting the spark of science.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 梁文匡、劉恩齊、彭鈺承和彭鈺林是自閉症人士，當中亦有輕度智障。有人叫他們做「星星的孩子」，他們的世界與眾不同，看事物有他們的角度。在家人和其他人的愛護和支持下，他們有成為了小提琴演奏級高手、在國際溜冰比賽屢次奪冠，更可以揚帆海外。與生俱來的情況他們無從選擇，但積極參與可以帶來改變，他們能照顧自己，融入社區，大家生活輕鬆可以一些.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
政正關你事
programme.desc: 文志賢醫生是威爾斯親王醫院的顧問醫生（急症室），從醫近四十年，一直堅守急症前線。他擁有豐富嘅前線工作經驗，亦曾任職過多間醫院嘅管理層。係2021年退休後，他又重新回到前線，回到見證他治病扶傷無數個日日夜夜的急症室，為市民服務。除此之外，文醫生亦將自己兩個兒子培養成骨科專科醫生，就連媳婦亦都是婦產科嘅醫生. . . 通過對話，讓我們瞭解文醫生杏林從業路的初心.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：Pam剪去長髮重新開始
programme.desc: Pam遭達小姐栽贓被捕，雖被Donovan保釋，卻遭其以「累了」為由分手，深受打擊。後Jessica提供關鍵證據，達小姐罪行曝光被捕。真相是Donovan為保護Pam免受其過去牽連，忍痛選擇離開。十個月後，Pam在谷先生表白與家人支持下逐漸療愈，決意剪去長髮，告別傷痛，迎接新生。而Donovan獨對姐姐墓碑，在孤獨中思念.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
周末大電影 : 陰陽錯
programme.desc: 保險公司調查主任古志明(譚詠麟飾)被派調查一宗個案的死因,而死者竟是他們所請的「碟仙」張小瑜(倪淑君飾)。好奇心驅使下,古積極進行調查。某夜,瑜的鬼魂突出現於古的居室,她的甜美樣子,幽默活潑的性格引起古的愛慕,古不惜放棄未婚妻 Ivy (葉童飾),與瑜開始一段人鬼戀。畢竟人鬼殊途,陰陽異極終不能相結合,最後只能留下甜蜜深刻的回憶.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.sub-title: Episode 5 “The Spark of Science: The Art of Running A Distinguished Award”
programme.desc: Science progresses rapidly and shapes our future. While fully enjoying the convenience brought by applied technologies, have we ever stopped and thought about whom and what insights the basic science, which laid the foundation for everything, actually originated from?. This episode covers the Future Science Prize 10th Anniversary Special Session, with the theme “How to Run a Successful Prize?”, and where leading global scientists gathered together. “Basic science” explores the origin of the universe, the essence of matter and the life mechanism, which, in spite of being abstract in nature, have far-reaching impacts. On the other hand, “applied science”, just like a relay, continues to transform the results into medical, engineering and electronic technologies, so as to improve human life. Many important scientific awards focus on basic research because it opens up endless possibilities. . How should a scientific award with credibility and long-term impact be operated? In this programme, Professor Anderson Ho-cheung SHUM is invited to be the docent, and listen to the practice wisdom on the selection mechanism, the fairness principle and talent motivation shared by the leading scientists together with the audience. A distinguished award is the key to igniting the spark of science.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 每年3月20日是世界口腔健康日，好好照顧牙齒其實是在投資未來的健康。很多人只有牙痛時才去看牙醫，殊不知口腔長期發炎或清潔不良會影響咀嚼、外觀，甚至是身體其他疾病的警號。從嬰兒出牙、乳齒換恆齒，不同成長期的蛀牙與牙周問題，若未妥善處理可能會引致長遠影響。今集請來牙醫講解學齡前到青少年常見的牙齒健康問題，以及拆解常見的口腔健康迷思，好讓家長為孩子從小打好口腔健康基礎。. 主持：鄭萃雯、胡志遠醫生. 嘉賓：姚嘉榕教授（香港大學牙醫學院兒童齒科講座教授）. ＃學童牙齒保健＃世界口腔健康日＃蛀牙＃乳齒換恆齒＃兒童牙膏＃漱口水＃牙齒檢查.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第一集 - 吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文 | 探索漢代「高科技」生活發明！
programme.desc: 新一季首集率先由星級嘉賓吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文，分享他們眼中最欣賞的中華文化魅力！三位嘉賓挑戰文學、歷史、傳統戲曲劇種、科技發展成就等等的主題，到底會難到他們嗎？更想不到的，是考歷史、考文化之餘，更要考三位嘉賓的畫功！漢代發明的燈具，展示古人設計的精妙，令嘉賓們大開眼界。究竟誰能憑豐富知識，獲得中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 星級嘉賓：吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#吳家樂#趙慧珊#黃劍文#雲南昆明#路南石林#漢代發明#雁魚銅燈.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
programme.sub-title: 第一集 : 北京延慶 - 激昂與溫柔
programme.desc: 踏入北京延慶的冬日山野，阮頌陽(Brian)與余茵娜(Yanna)攜手，從地底冰雪激昂，走向高山御風暢快，再落腳農家爐火旁，穿梭於延慶冬天的多重面貌，深入感受北京冬天的冰雪魅力與暖意。如遊龍盤踞山脊的賽道「雪游龍」，正上演鋼架雪車國際賽事，Brian與Yanna觀賽後欲親身體驗當中令人屏息的快感，登上「雷霆雪車」，於賽道聞名的360度回旋彎道，感受心跳加速的極限速度與激情。及後，二人轉戰「雪飛燕」，由最基本的走路、跌倒開始學習滑雪技巧，他們可能迅速懂得滑雪，於異鄉感受御風而行的樂趣？. 日落時分，Brian與Yanna圍坐農家小院，品味延慶柳溝村馳名「豆腐宴」。隨吃隨加，充滿農家暖意，完美體現當地人冬日「暖洋洋」的愜意生活。飽食暖衣過後，在峽谷中穿梭，卻又藏住另一番激情.

programme.title: 體壇快閃
programme.desc: 體育新聞: Hyrox 香港代表隊選拔賽. 焦點人物:梁寶儀(中國香港單車代表). 嘉賓訪談:林靜欣(中國香港短道速滑代表).

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Although locally produced fishery and agricultural products account for only a small proportion of total consumption, local products are still particularly appealing to many consumers. In the face of high production costs, a shortage of talent, land scarcity, and pressures for upgrading and transformation, how can the local fishery and agricultural sector overcome these challenges and continue to operate.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集走進年輕主廚崔準佑（Junwoo）在香港開設的新派韓食餐廳，見證他如何將母親承傳的釀醬智慧，化為盤中的現代味譜。. 從傳統醬油蝦到顛覆想像的松露餃子，崔準佑把韓國的風土記憶融入香港的飲食脈搏，決心將韓食文化分享給這座城市。節目跟隨他走入西貢，展開一場關於香港鮮味的欣賞與對話。. 韓食文化，就如他在香港的生活一樣，仍有更多值得探索的可能.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 在小學語文課本，一直閃耀着一個神童的傳說，他就是懂得利用浮力给大象秤體重的曹沖。1,800多年前，小曹沖如此逆天的智商的確令人瞠目結舌，再加上他過早夭折，史料極少，更引發了人們對「曹沖稱象」這個典故的質疑。為此，科學求證人高澤民將前往雲南、河北、遼寧三地，探究其中的玄妙.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 「身輕如燕」的「燕」是漢成帝的傳奇皇后—趙飛燕。相傳，趙飛燕曾在跳舞時，險些被風吹倒。侍郎馮無方扔掉手中的笙，飛身托起趙飛燕，飛燕在托舉之下繼續從容舞蹈。這便是「身輕如燕」的典故。那麼，「身輕如燕」到底是一種甚麼狀態？科學求證人高澤民將一探究竟.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集會去參觀和寒町的南瓜。因為冬至和萬聖節的追求增加，整個南瓜生產都大幅提升，現時已經有二十三個品種之多。今次探訪，會直擊收割，以至分類的過程.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚們分工合作，小特和德仔負責去砍柴，佩佩和迪迪則留在家中打掃。過程中，他們互相發現對方未能完成任務，甚至弄得一團糟.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚特攻隊從暴風雪中救出一隻灰色的小海鸚，這隻可憐的小傢伙感到孤單及難過，儘管大家努力想逗他開心，但他只想找媽媽. . .

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 帕夫突然出現在海鸚俱樂部門口，並請海鸚特攻隊給他一個暫時棲身的地方。善良的海鸚們收留了他，但沒想到帕夫漸漸顯露出真面目.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥和小米吃午飯，小麥討厭蔬菜，小米說對大腦有益。小麥到史前世界尋找美食，遇到沙沙羅和奶昔。最後，他看到巨大的蔬菜，餓到暈倒，醒來後決定嘗試，發現蔬菜很好吃.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 古董大盜再次歸來，可家裡只有灶君和子涵在，電話線被惡意剪斷、家門眼看也要失守。為了拖延時等待警察救援，灶君和子涵和古董大盜展開了一場智力角逐，最終有驚無險地躲過追擊，再次將古董大盜抓捕歸案.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 斯洛文尼亞因其高品質的蜂蜜而享譽國際。然而，它與蜜蜂的聯繫遠不僅限於蜂蜜的採集。養蜂人每天都在努力，致力於保護當地的純種蜜蜂——克尼奧拉蜜蜂（Carniolian bee）的純潔性.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在1970年代和1980年代，西西里蜜蜂曾瀕臨滅絕，但在養蜂人卡洛·阿莫德奧（Carlo Amodeo）巨大的努力和無盡熱情下得以挽救。如今，這位西西里蜜蜂的大師擁有超過1800個蜂巢，分佈於西西里島東北部的埃奧利亞群島，這些地方如今成為他所稱的「女皇」們的唯一庇護所.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: With the opening of the western section of the East Coast Boardwalk beneath the North Point Eastern Corridor to the public, Hong Kong’s waterfront development has reached a major milestone. . The government has proposed making better use of waterfront resources, including piloting the introduction of dining, retail and commercial elements, and the Legislative Council has just passed the Protection of the Harbour (Amendment) Bill at third reading. How can stakeholders enhance the waterfront’s flexibility while ensuring the protection of Victoria Harbour.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 文志賢醫生是威爾斯親王醫院的顧問醫生（急症室），從醫近四十年，一直堅守急症前線。他擁有豐富嘅前線工作經驗，亦曾任職過多間醫院嘅管理層。係2021年退休後，他又重新回到前線，回到見證他治病扶傷無數個日日夜夜的急症室，為市民服務。除此之外，文醫生亦將自己兩個兒子培養成骨科專科醫生，就連媳婦亦都是婦產科嘅醫生. . . 通過對話，讓我們瞭解文醫生杏林從業路的初心.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: Environmental protection is the heartbeat of civilisation, that pulses across mountains and rivers. The technological revolution in transportation is making travel smarter, more efficient and closer to nature. From the lightning-fast steel dragons, to ground-level subways with virtual tracks; From overhead charging of trucks, to low-altitude flying cars, a green transportation network is weaving a future with the sky and land connected.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：齊天帶肖艷秋倒賣外匯券
programme.desc: 佟曉梅知道肖春生手術成功但右腿的感知弱，她隱瞞這個事實。肖春生回到家後嘗試站起來失敗。佟曉梅為了肖春生能更好的恢復，她來請求院長希望春生可以每週來一次康復中心。齊天帶著肖豔秋買賣外匯券賺錢。齊天找了黑子他們一起賺錢。到開榜日子，陳宏軍打算向葉芳求婚.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：佟曉梅為肖春生學按摩和針灸
programme.desc: 肖春生住進了醫院，梁東來到醫院看望肖春生，安慰肖春生依然是大英雄。梁東推著肖春生來到了他練功的地方，肖春生沒有受到他的徒弟不一樣的眼神，感到開心。佟曉梅為了幫助肖春生儘快恢復，她學習按摩手法和針灸。陳宏軍表示去海關是自己的夢想，葉芳選擇支持他.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 香港三面環海，淡水資源卻長期匱乏，從薄扶林水塘的率先興建，到大潭、城門水塘相繼落成，再到萬宜水庫的浩大工程，港人不斷截流築壩，與天爭水。本集將回顧香港百多年來水務建設的歷程，細說一座座水塘如何改變山川地貌，既解決民生所需，亦塑造出青山綠水的郊野景致。. 主持:. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究).

programme.title: 運動教室31(第三季)
programme.sub-title: 運動教室31 (第３季) 第十集
programme.desc: 運動攀登及滑水.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台 : 諾瑪
programme.desc: 《演藝盛薈．開放舞台》為觀眾帶來一部充滿矛盾和悲壯的愛情歌劇，被譽為美聲歌劇的顛峰之作，意大利作曲家貝里尼二幕歌劇名作《諾瑪》。. 故事發生約公元前50年，受羅馬帝國攻佔的高盧，族人憎恨羅馬的管治，雙方勢成水火。高盧女祭司諾瑪，卻與羅馬軍官波利昂愛上，更誕下兩名兒子，但好景不常，波利昂漸漸愛上諾瑪好友阿桃姬莎。最終諾瑪與波利昂的愛情以悲劇收場。. 《諾瑪》歌劇片段由非凡美樂製作及提供，資深歌劇製作人盧景文導演、葉詠媛擔任指揮、杜明姬(Meryl Dominguez)及車尼士(Dominick Chenes)主演。. 主要演員：. 杜明姬飾諾瑪. 車尼士飾波利昂. 金采兒飾阿桃姬莎. 呂戈飾奧羅維. 非凡美樂. 非凡美樂於2008年成立，創團成員是一群熱心於表演藝術的支持者，在表演藝術的發展方面擁有豐富的經驗。主要目標是推廣富創意的音樂、歌劇和歌曲藝術的欣賞、教育和表演，並為藝術新秀的創作和專業發展提供機會。推崇的表演形式強調高雅的美學意識、誠實的藝術內涵、簡約和細緻的演繹。. 盧景文(導演/監製). 盧景文於1993年獲委任為香港演藝學院校長，直至2004年退休。曾獲香港大學、香港理工大學、香港演藝學院及英國皇家藝術學會頒授榮譽院士，亦獲香港特區政府頒發香港銅紫荊及銀紫荊星章。. 杜明姬Meryl Dominguez (飾諾瑪). 古巴裔美藉女高音，專注於歌劇曲目、藝術歌曲和當代音樂。曾參與多個歌劇演出，包括《茶花女》、《愛情靈藥》等。. 車尼士 Dominick Chenes (飾波利昂). 作為費城聲樂藝術學院之畢業生，車尼士分別在2013及2016年，首次亮相於林肯表演藝術中心的艾莉絲‧塔利廳和紐約卡內基大廳。他曾演唱《波希米亞生涯》中魯道夫而大受歡迎。. 金采兒 Hilary Ginther (飾阿桃姬莎). 美藉女中音，曾參與多個曾歌劇演出，包括《亨利八世》、《聖女貞德》等。. 呂戈 Ricardo Lugo (飾奧羅維). 男低音，曾參與多個歌劇演出，包括《蝴蝶夫人》、《托斯卡》、《愛情靈藥》等。亦曾參與不同的音樂會，包括紐約歌劇院管弦樂團、波多黎各交響樂團、巴赫音樂節等.

programme.title: 美樂說
programme.desc: 電影《淪落人》裏飾演菲律賓外傭的姬素·孔尚治，原來現實中是一位歌手和演員，除了表演外，亦對幼兒藝術教育很有抱負。植根香港的她，又怎樣看這個城市和這裏的人？. 有豐富音樂劇表演經驗的姬素·孔尚治為大家帶來多首耳熟能詳的名曲，由國語金曲到電影主題曲，讓我們聽聽她悅耳的演繹。. 姬素·孔尚治生於菲律賓，為馬尼拉雅典耀大學的政治學系學士和文學碩士；於香港教育大學取得幼兒教育學系博士學位。. 主持：高德儀. 高德儀，新一代實力派女指揮家，香港青少年管弦樂團藝術總監兼總指揮。. 演奏曲目：. 《至少還有你》 曲：陳匡榮詞：林夕. A Whole New World 電影《阿拉丁》歌曲. Never Enough 電影《大娛樂家》歌曲.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 小四學生寶姸最近因為媽媽的管教而感到煩惱，覺得自己被迫做不想做的事，失去了自由。Harry哥哥決定出手相助，親自到學校了解情況；同時，貓頭鷹博士也透過《基本法》第四條與大家一起思考「自由」的真正意義。究竟寶姸的煩惱背後，藏着甚麼原因？Harry哥哥又能否幫她解開心結？. 《基本法》第四條：. 香港特別行政區依法保障香港特別行政區居民和其他人的權利和自由。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 海拔253米高的龙虎山，是香港中西区一座山峰，在1998年政府才将附近一带正式划成龙虎山郊野公园，亦是香港面积最少的一个郊野公园。. 虽然占地比较少，但龙虎山郊野公园充满特色，例如公园内有被列入香港二级历史建筑的松林废堡，记录昔日香港保卫战的历史。. 除了人文历史之外，公园内也有丰富的生态，在河溪范围孕育着米虾及溪蟹等生物。仔细观察更会在公园内，找到豪猪、果子狸、短吻果蝠等生物的足迹.

programme.title: 體壇無界限
programme.desc: NBL全國男子籃球聯賽進入季後賽、且看香港金牛能否順利晉級。另外亦會繼續跟進西甲籃及國際馬術聯會障礙賽等賽事.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 每一滴的守護- 香港母乳庫
programme.desc: 「香港母乳庫」是醫院管理局轄下服務，設於香港兒童醫院，負責協調母乳的捐贈、收集、篩選、儲存及分配，全程保障母乳品質與安全，以確保在母親無法餵哺或母乳不足時，為高風險嬰兒提供安全優質的捐贈母乳。節目深情記錄媽媽們無私奉獻的感人故事，展現醫護人員嚴謹細心的守護，從早產嬰兒的生命奇蹟，到媽媽們彼此扶持的溫暖瞬間，傳遞出真摯、無價的母愛.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
周末大電影 : 鐵血神探
programme.desc: 阿倫狄龍飾演執法者警探高文，為了搗破毒品交易，查案至海邊一個寧靜小鎮，邂逅美豔的嘉菲(嘉芙蓮丹露飾).

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: Environmental protection is the heartbeat of civilisation, that pulses across mountains and rivers. The technological revolution in transportation is making travel smarter, more efficient and closer to nature. From the lightning-fast steel dragons, to ground-level subways with virtual tracks; From overhead charging of trucks, to low-altitude flying cars, a green transportation network is weaving a future with the sky and land connected.

programme.desc: 小四學生寶姸最近因為媽媽的管教而感到煩惱，覺得自己被迫做不想做的事，失去了自由。Harry哥哥決定出手相助，親自到學校了解情況；同時，貓頭鷹博士也透過《基本法》第四條與大家一起思考「自由」的真正意義。究竟寶姸的煩惱背後，藏着甚麼原因？Harry哥哥又能否幫她解開心結？. 《基本法》第四條：. 香港特別行政區依法保障香港特別行政區居民和其他人的權利和自由。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 2006年參加新秀歌唱比賽入行的沈震軒，演藝之路雖以拍攝劇集及電影為主，同時又發展健身事業及網絡頻道，但其實他始終心繫音樂，雖然推出的音樂作品不多，但一直用心創作。今集《港樂．講樂》 Sammy帶來他的兩首作品，及暢談他的音樂夢、演藝路。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 黎展峯. 歌曲：. 《最幸運的平凡人》. 《我真的很好.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.sub-title: 戴沛權 ： 以科研關愛世界
programme.desc: 戴沛權，氣候科學家與環境教育家，現任香港中文大學地球與環境科學系教授。他從小熱愛自然生態，中學會考獲8A佳績，雖獲醫學院的入場券，卻選擇了一條與眾不同的道路；為了追尋環保夢，他遠赴麻省理工學院及哈佛大學攻讀環境科學。他的追夢旅程仍然繼續；他回港於中大任教，主力研究空氣污染、氣候變化對生態與農業的影響，並參與無數傳媒訪問、中小學講座等。戴教授憑其教育熱誠、推動公眾環保意識等貢獻，榮獲2024年香港十大傑出青年。. 本集節目將跟隨戴教授走進課堂與自然環境，探索他如何以科學與教育回應氣候危機.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: With the opening of the western section of the East Coast Boardwalk beneath the North Point Eastern Corridor to the public, Hong Kong’s waterfront development has reached a major milestone. . The government has proposed making better use of waterfront resources, including piloting the introduction of dining, retail and commercial elements, and the Legislative Council has just passed the Protection of the Harbour (Amendment) Bill at third reading. How can stakeholders enhance the waterfront’s flexibility while ensuring the protection of Victoria Harbour.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 斯洛文尼亞因其高品質的蜂蜜而享譽國際。然而，它與蜜蜂的聯繫遠不僅限於蜂蜜的採集。養蜂人每天都在努力，致力於保護當地的純種蜜蜂——克尼奧拉蜜蜂（Carniolian bee）的純潔性.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在1970年代和1980年代，西西里蜜蜂曾瀕臨滅絕，但在養蜂人卡洛·阿莫德奧（Carlo Amodeo）巨大的努力和無盡熱情下得以挽救。如今，這位西西里蜜蜂的大師擁有超過1800個蜂巢，分佈於西西里島東北部的埃奧利亞群島，這些地方如今成為他所稱的「女皇」們的唯一庇護所.

programme.title: 不就是拔河麼
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 明承大奮力決戰 U23比賽
programme.desc: 經過幾場比賽明承大的積分在晉級邊緣，必須拿下最後一局才能順利出線。雷明厚著臉皮守在父親雷天祥的床前，無論父親怎麼奚落也不離開，父子重拾兒時的回憶，雷明感到自己虧欠父親良多，而雷父也漸漸瞭解到兒子的努力，反過來勸雷明回到賽場.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 每一滴的守護- 香港母乳庫

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.sub-title: 第五集：坤草益母 -益母草
programme.desc: 在遼闊的中華大地上，有一種本草在大江南北恣意生長。它無懼氣候的差異，不拘泥土地情況，以千年未變的繁盛之姿呵護著女性的健康。它，就是益母草。本期節目帶你走近自然饋贈女性的傳奇本草，在古今交融中探索益母草的無限未來.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 當歸，是調味的料，更是治病的藥。它從外形上看，與近親芹菜、香菜十分相似。當歸的主要藥效是讓人的氣血各有所歸，這也是它名字的由來。本期節目與你共同奔赴高原之上，尋覓野生當歸的蹤跡，發現當歸背後的故事.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：鄭北得知毒毛巾的分銷方式
programme.desc: 鄭北暗中抓毒品賣家，審問之下，得知了毒毛巾的分銷方式：兩車毛巾運進酒店車庫，一車乾淨、一車有毒，只停留十分鐘。這段時間，乾淨毛巾送進飯店，毒毛巾快速拆分。大車進、小車出—多量私家車等在一旁，接上毒毛巾火速離開。而統管拆包零售的負責人正是白玲.

programme.title: 雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集：可疑的外貿公司老闆
programme.desc: 姜迎紫通知林智達，販毒集團主腦有事商議，林智達便帶著林江等前往赴會。姜小海拎著一個旅行袋走進會議室。原來，林智達私賣冰毒被販毒集團主腦察覺了。專案組在搜查另一單火車運毒案的過程中，懷疑外貿公司老闆就是販毒集團主腦，專案組開始盯梢和偷聽外貿公司.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米陪小麥玩電子遊戲，小麥生氣不想玩。他們請蛋仔到史前世界，遇到贏得所有遊戲的翼龍哆來咪。蛋仔建議找大家能玩的遊戲，小麥想到「一二三木頭人」。比賽中大家開心，小麥明白適合每個人的遊戲最重要.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 大桔送作業本到學校，卻被杜老師誤以為是玩具，鎖在儲物櫃裡。菲菲召喚如福解救大桔，但幾次嘗試後，大桔被杜老師塞進紙箱，鎖在櫃子裡，準備學期結束後再還給菲菲.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 土地公外出請求灶君帶班一天，子軒偷聽兩人的談話，潛入土地廟，陰差陽錯中損壞了小鎮司南導致小鎮處於失重狀態，兩人不得不歷經艱險，回家找爸爸求助.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：李善德請教是否有更近的路
programme.desc: 李善德得知阿柴住在大庾山，請教阿柴是否知道山上有更近的路。阿柴告訴李善德，當年有一個叫阿土的人，天生反骨，不愛聽部族裏的老的話，留在山裏做峒人。他偏喜歡出去跟城鄉人打交道，尤其嚮往嶺南的生活.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 特殊的孩子要成長，背後的家人就是推手。這些父母在覺察孩子有特殊的一刻已經備受煎熬，在漫長的歲月中，除了要付出無窮精力與耐性，同時要默默忍受別人不解的異樣眼光。他們的情緒健康亦同樣需要得到正視。. 劉國威Wallace的兒子是自閉症和輕度智障、翁太的女兒是唐氏飛魚翁欣怡、徐江琼的女兒有雷特氏症、鍾曼姿關注SEN家長，今集主持Marco和Vita會和他們傾計，談談照顧者的關注，分享兩代人如何才能共同健康成長.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十七集：温莉處心積慮接近丁啟偉
programme.desc: 温莉通過孫華鼎的介紹來到搏適集團找到老總丁兆光談生意，乘機接近丁總的兒子小丁。温莉知道小丁喜歡電影，便投其所好告知他自己也是個電影迷，兩人熟落起來。此時，馬麗麗走來律師所，表示要以夏舒曾收下了她轉交給許建設信件的視頻，告她們三人助自己和許建設串供.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 隱身於重慶大廈的非洲菜小店，由加納人Paul 及香港人Selina兩夫婦於十年前創立。他們希望透過異國美食，例如加納羊腩金錢肚堅果濃湯和原條炸鯽魚，為客人帶來一刻喘息的空間。兩口子一起並肩作戰，堂食、外賣和到會都一一做好，可惜的是Paul於2024年因病離世，但Selina會堅持把餐廳營運下去，延續Paul的精神.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 萬能雙手
programme.sub-title: 萬能雙手 The Remarkable Hand: From Touch to Triumph
programme.desc: 我們的一雙手，每隻都有二十四塊骨頭，堪稱解剖學上的奇蹟。我們可以用手來書寫，來創造東西；由於擁有精細肌動技能，人類的手是完美的多功能工具。. 電腦逐漸取代手工勞動，手機逐漸取代筆，可是我們的手和手指，在精細肌動能力和感知功能方面，絕對難以被超越。而往往只有遇到意外或罹患疾病之後，人們才意識到這超級工具是何等珍貴。. 我們的手可以舉起重物，可以牢牢抓住東西，或者握住一枝筆，控制它在紙張上精準地留下片言雙語。我們的手指可以觸碰，撫摸，或者在鋼琴鍵盤上飛舞。. 在德國科隆體育大學，英高科保沙及其團隊在電競選手身上進行性能測試，從科學角度研究他們慣用哪一隻手，以至手指練就的技巧如何可以一一加強。. 人類的手也屬感官之一，可以幫助視障人士出入無阻。我們的指尖有很多觸覺小體，令這部位比身體其他部位的皮膚更敏感。當人們遭遇極端情況，例如因意外或者截肢失去一隻手之後，才知道手的價值。世界各地的神經生物學家正在研究開發可以讓患者再次用手指去抓握和感覺的義肢。. 本節目跟進了孩子學習用手書寫的艱難過程，亦直擊了經驗豐富的鋼琴家運用手部精細肌動的演奏，也通過抱石運動員的日常，展示人命如何真正掌握在自己手中。在電光火石之間，人的雙手和大腦究竟發生了甚麼事.

programme.desc: 小米陪小麥玩電子遊戲，小麥生氣不想玩。他們請蛋仔到史前世界，遇到贏得所有遊戲的翼龍哆來咪。蛋仔建議找大家能玩的遊戲，小麥想到「一二三木頭人」。比賽中大家開心，小麥明白適合每個人的遊戲最重要.

雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：販毒集團決定照常運毒
programme.desc: 疑似販毒集團主腦和姜小海得知鄭北已經盯上了自己，但也明白，專案組不行動是因為沒有關鍵販毒證據，如果按原計劃可能落入陷阱。然而，這次的運毒量龐大，放棄意味著損失巨大。對於自負的販毒主腦來說，販毒是他最擅長的事情。他決定：照常運毒，但打時間差並改變方案.

programme.title: 雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：疑似販毒主腦被警方包圍
programme.desc: 局長坐鎮辦公室指揮工作，哈嵐警方早已和盛城警方匯合，在各關卡佈下了天羅地網。鄭北預判了疑似販毒主腦的預判，隨後決定按兵不動，演一場戲給販毒集團看。鄭北與顧一燃駕找到了泡毒地點。另一邊，疑似販毒主腦意識到自己已被包圍，他告訴姜小海不要返回，快逃跑.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥發現小米被玩具擋住，院子亂糟糟，於是他們去史前世界。那裡更混亂，沙沙羅找不到枕頭，木瓜無法跳舞。最終找到雷卡，大家一起清理後，小米明白要尊重小麥的空間.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 周末社區舉辦廚藝大賽，菲菲嫲嫲和富貴嫲嫲鬥氣，決定參賽。菲菲想打探其他選手的狀況，朝風趁機將能讓物體膨脹的千年蓼花發酵粉灑進了嫲嫲的麵團裏.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君為了奪取子軒子涵的關注，撒謊告訴他們小鎮外的稻田有一隻神秘田螺怪，卻不料引起子軒子涵好奇，兩人相約朋友去稻田探險。為了不露餡，灶君開始阻擋小朋友探險的腳步，卻反而促使他們早早到達探險地，沒想到稻田裡真的有田螺怪.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：鄭平安想辦法打探消息
programme.desc: 駱駝查到了斜眼馮與藍哥有些淵源。但是鬥雞坊人多眼雜，自己行走暗處不便露面，需要鄭平安想辦法去打探進一步的消息。鄭平安來到鬥雞坊，找藍哥查明阿土下落.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十八集：羅英子回擊馬麗麗的敲詐
programme.desc: 羅英子當面揭穿了馬麗麗的謊言，她害怕羅英子掌握了她非法轉移許建設財產的證據，只能答應寫下一份保證書，承諾以後不會再找羅英子和邱華的麻煩。另一邊，陳碩回到涇北向羅英子和方麗虹介紹了有關溫莉的情況，羅英子決定和邱華一同到青陽查探温莉老家成長的地方.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 快歌節拍強勁，令人聞歌起舞，慢歌溫柔深情，扣人心弦。哥哥張國榮的舞台魔力，不止令老樂迷懷念不已，更吸引到許多新生代，在他離開之後才紛紛成為他的粉絲。百聽不厭，歷久常新，更擁有不斷滋長的生命力，是為不朽。在這個春暖花開的時候，讓我們再一次重溫張國榮在舞台上的完美演出。. 主持. 李志剛.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.desc: 在這集節目中，維克托展開了征服非洲最高峰——吉力馬扎羅山的挑戰。但這趟旅程跟以往不一樣，他不再獨自上路，同行的還有八位來自塞納・聖但尼省的青年女性。. 阿比、黛樂菲、慧德、阿雪、阿花、璐哈雅、麗欣、依曼都懷著同一個夢想，就是成為貧困的93省首支登上吉力馬扎羅山的女子隊伍。她們的處境很相近：從未攀登過高山，卻同樣燃燒著決心，要打破自身極限，以及衝破周遭無形的枷鎖，為自己開闢一片天地。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年3月31日 星期二 晚上10時. . In this new episode, Victor takes on a monumental challenge—climbing Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak. But this time, he’s not going alone. . Joining him are Abir, Dorothée, Widad, Aché, Wafa , Nourayat, Rayanne, and Imane—eight young women from Seine-Saint-Denis (the so-called "93"), one of mainland France's poorest departments. These women share a bold dream: to become its first all-female team to summit Kilimanjaro. None have ever climbed a mountain before. Yet together, they burn with determination—to shatter their limits and the glass ceiling hovering above them all. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.03.31 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 快歌節拍強勁，令人聞歌起舞，慢歌溫柔深情，扣人心弦。哥哥張國榮的舞台魔力，不止令老樂迷懷念不已，更吸引到許多新生代，在他離開之後才紛紛成為他的粉絲。百聽不厭，歷久常新，更擁有不斷滋長的生命力，是為不朽。在這個春暖花開的時候，讓我們再一次重溫張國榮在舞台上的完美演出。. 主持. 李志剛.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第一集 - 吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文 | 探索漢代「高科技」生活發明！
programme.desc: 新一季首集率先由星級嘉賓吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文，分享他們眼中最欣賞的中華文化魅力！三位嘉賓挑戰文學、歷史、傳統戲曲劇種、科技發展成就等等的主題，到底會難到他們嗎？更想不到的，是考歷史、考文化之餘，更要考三位嘉賓的畫功！漢代發明的燈具，展示古人設計的精妙，令嘉賓們大開眼界。究竟誰能憑豐富知識，獲得中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 星級嘉賓：吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#吳家樂#趙慧珊#黃劍文#雲南昆明#路南石林#漢代發明#雁魚銅燈.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十八集：羅英子回擊馬麗麗的敲詐
programme.desc: 羅英子當面揭穿了馬麗麗的謊言，她害怕羅英子掌握了她非法轉移許建設財產的證據，只能答應寫下一份保證書，承諾以後不會再找羅英子和邱華的麻煩。另一邊，陳碩回到涇北向羅英子和方麗虹介紹了有關溫莉的情況，羅英子決定和邱華一同到青陽查探温莉老家成長的地方.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.desc: 在這集節目中，維克托展開了征服非洲最高峰——吉力馬扎羅山的挑戰。但這趟旅程跟以往不一樣，他不再獨自上路，同行的還有八位來自塞納・聖但尼省的青年女性。. 阿比、黛樂菲、慧德、阿雪、阿花、璐哈雅、麗欣、依曼都懷著同一個夢想，就是成為貧困的93省首支登上吉力馬扎羅山的女子隊伍。她們的處境很相近：從未攀登過高山，卻同樣燃燒著決心，要打破自身極限，以及衝破周遭無形的枷鎖，為自己開闢一片天地。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年3月31日 星期二 晚上10時. . In this new episode, Victor takes on a monumental challenge—climbing Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak. But this time, he’s not going alone. . Joining him are Abir, Dorothée, Widad, Aché, Wafa , Nourayat, Rayanne, and Imane—eight young women from Seine-Saint-Denis (the so-called "93"), one of mainland France's poorest departments. These women share a bold dream: to become its first all-female team to summit Kilimanjaro. None have ever climbed a mountain before. Yet together, they burn with determination—to shatter their limits and the glass ceiling hovering above them all. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.03.31 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥發現小米被玩具擋住，院子亂糟糟，於是他們去史前世界。那裡更混亂，沙沙羅找不到枕頭，木瓜無法跳舞。最終找到雷卡，大家一起清理後，小米明白要尊重小麥的空間.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 周末社區舉辦廚藝大賽，菲菲嫲嫲和富貴嫲嫲鬥氣，決定參賽。菲菲想打探其他選手的狀況，朝風趁機將能讓物體膨脹的千年蓼花發酵粉灑進了嫲嫲的麵團裏.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君為了奪取子軒子涵的關注，撒謊告訴他們小鎮外的稻田有一隻神秘田螺怪，卻不料引起子軒子涵好奇，兩人相約朋友去稻田探險。為了不露餡，灶君開始阻擋小朋友探險的腳步，卻反而促使他們早早到達探險地，沒想到稻田裡真的有田螺怪.

programme.title: 不就是拔河麼
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集: 七人迎來終極一戰
programme.desc: 眾人為了帶著伍青的信念上場，並以七人對八人，迎戰自己的宿敵省體大。一路走來，明承大百折不撓、團結一心的精神也使得省體大深感震動，明承大近乎無畏的堅持令省體大重新正視這個曾經看不起的對手。[全劇完.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：顧一燃帶著鄭北找到地道
programme.desc: 泡毒工廠一切塵埃落地之時，鄭北接到趙曉光的對講，說製毒廠那邊控制住了，但是疑似販毒主腦躲在地堡，那裡固若金湯，警方正在準備炸門。鄭北要折回去支援，卻忽然被顧一燃拉住。顧一燃帶著鄭北找到泡毒廠隱蔽的地道，二人順地道走，原來販毒集團一直從地下運輸毒品.

programme.title: 雪迷宮
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：市內發生爆炸
programme.desc: 鄭北去提審疑似販毒集團主腦，但他不配合。就在這時，警局外，爆炸的巨響猛然傳來。鄭北被叫出審訊室，市局緊急通知，城中百貨發生爆炸，嫌疑人稱全市共埋下十顆炸彈，炸了一顆。全市警力全部出動排查拆彈，專案組也先暫停工作，配合行動。同時，姜迎紫在醫院脅持護士.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和小麥爭玩望遠鏡，茜茜提議去史前世界。那裡紅豆和綠豆因棕櫚葉打架。小米分葉子，但雙胞胎弄髒茜茜。大家去河裡清理，最終找到大石頭，紅豆和綠豆學會分享，三人組明白謙讓的重要性.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
家有灶君
programme.desc: 子軒子涵之間再次爆發兄妹矛盾，子軒散發出來的負能量吸引了小衰神。一個利用讓激發人們產生更多負能量的睚眥怪，附著在人體上，以達到破壞趙家、一切照計劃進行，小鎮充滿各種爭吵，危機時刻灶君堅守本心，利用神環將睚眥怪一網打盡，小衰神只得敗興而歸.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：何有光對阿土拔刀
programme.desc: 阿土見到何有光有連連掙扎倒退，大喊親眼看到他帶着火油進了騎鯨樓，燒死了海虎。何有光氣得拔刀。李善德將阿土收養的瞎姑娘，送到了繡坊，給了她一個歸宿。瞎姑娘將一條刺繡送給李善德.

programme.title: 同心為民 公務員好故事
31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第十六集：瓦努阿圖 - 救急扶危的醫生
programme.desc: 班克斯群島位處南太平洋島國瓦努阿圖的北部，與世隔絕。每當群島有人生病或出現醫療事故，島上九千名居民就只能依靠Mark Turnbull醫生和他的橙色小型飛機。 作為方圓數百公里唯一的醫生，只有他能夠在這些火山島充滿危險的簡陋跑道上升降。有時，即使天氣多變，他仍可能要到訪四至五個島，為島處理牙齒問題、運送孕婦，甚至在熱帶樹林的地上進行全身麻醉手術。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年1月15日 星期一晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 中國科學革命
programme.desc: Our war on disease, is one that’s been fought throughout human history. It’s killed and maimed more people than any other conflict, and continues to challenge us. This is the story of three Chinese scientists who are working on the frontline of our battle with disease. From precision gene editing to create new animal models for testing novel drugs designed to defeat Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease, to the scientists working to combat kidney disease by tackling air pollution, and cutting edge STEM cell research that promises to grow brand new, tailor-made organs to replace those damaged by disease; these ambitious goals have the potential to improve lives across the globe.

programme.title: 行政長官表揚榜 2025
programme.sub-title: Chief Executive's Award for Exemplary Performance 2025
programme.desc: The Chief Executive’s Award for Exemplary Performance aims to give recognition to meritorious and exemplary teams or individuals in the civil service, with a view to encouraging civil servants to constantly strive for excellence. It also enables the public to have a better understanding of the Government's work and the excellence of the civil service through wide publicity. . The HKSAR Search and Rescue Team to quake-stricken areas in Myanmar in March 2025 and the Inter-departmental Preparation Team for Kai Tak Sports Park (KTSP) Commissioning were awarded a new round of the Chief Executive's Award for Exemplary Performance.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 文志賢醫生是威爾斯親王醫院的顧問醫生（急症室），從醫近四十年，一直堅守急症前線。他擁有豐富嘅前線工作經驗，亦曾任職過多間醫院嘅管理層。係2021年退休後，他又重新回到前線，回到見證他治病扶傷無數個日日夜夜的急症室，為市民服務。除此之外，文醫生亦將自己兩個兒子培養成骨科專科醫生，就連媳婦亦都是婦產科嘅醫生. . . 通過對話，讓我們瞭解文醫生杏林從業路的初心.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 每一滴的守護- 香港母乳庫
programme.desc: 「香港母乳庫」是醫院管理局轄下服務，設於香港兒童醫院，負責協調母乳的捐贈、收集、篩選、儲存及分配，全程保障母乳品質與安全，以確保在母親無法餵哺或母乳不足時，為高風險嬰兒提供安全優質的捐贈母乳。節目深情記錄媽媽們無私奉獻的感人故事，展現醫護人員嚴謹細心的守護，從早產嬰兒的生命奇蹟，到媽媽們彼此扶持的溫暖瞬間，傳遞出真摯、無價的母愛.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第一集 - 吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文 | 探索漢代「高科技」生活發明！
programme.desc: 新一季首集率先由星級嘉賓吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文，分享他們眼中最欣賞的中華文化魅力！三位嘉賓挑戰文學、歷史、傳統戲曲劇種、科技發展成就等等的主題，到底會難到他們嗎？更想不到的，是考歷史、考文化之餘，更要考三位嘉賓的畫功！漢代發明的燈具，展示古人設計的精妙，令嘉賓們大開眼界。究竟誰能憑豐富知識，獲得中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 星級嘉賓：吳家樂、趙慧珊、黃劍文. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#吳家樂#趙慧珊#黃劍文#雲南昆明#路南石林#漢代發明#雁魚銅燈.

programme.title: 2025年度傑出運動員選舉頒獎典禮
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.desc: A superfood has become popular in recent years. Not only is it an antioxidant, but it also helps to control body weight, enriches the blood and enhances performance during exercise! It is beetroot, which is known as the “ruby of vegetables”. In this episode, the “Food Fanatic” will take us to a local farm to harvest of three varieties of beetroot, and they will also show us how to prepare healthy and delicious “ABC juice”. Meanwhile, the chef host will teach us how to cook two Western-style dishes with colourful ingredients that are appetising and suitable for vegetarians. The two guests in this episode, artiste Ngo Ka Nin and Consultant (Surgery) Dr Irene Lo, have been vegetarians for many years. They will share their tips about healthy vegetarian diets while enjoying their meal, and introduce dietary principles such as “whole food diet” and “raw food diet”. . Hosts: Icy WONG, Andy Dark (Chef). Guests: Ngo Ka Nin, Dr Irene Lo (Consultant (Surgery)).
